reviews.review: Leandros can suck a fat one
a must play for any warhammer fan

I bought this game on XB back in the day, and I instantly got dragged into the WH40K universe. Now after so many years, I play it again and I can you this - it's still awesome game. Same but better with Anniversary Ed.
Buy it, you won't regret it, and soon you will have SM2
It's a solid game for an oldie, but purchase this ON SALE!!!

♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ this game is good!

Few things in life give you the feeling of raw power better than recieving a war hammer and a jump pack.

If you want to play a good shoot-em-up game, not feel bad about it it and feel powerful af, this is a game for you.

And if you don't want that? Trust me, play it and you WILL want that.


Little more in-depth:
The game is over 10 years old, yet it doesn't feel like that. It looks great even today (there might've been a graphics update, idk, it's an anniversary edition and i didn't look up what that means tbh) and the controls feel great too. 
Story, while being secondary, is still good and serves as a great intro into the world of WH40k. The world is filled with details, enemies and characters that any WH fan will absolutely love.
The weapon selection can feel small for some, but this gives each weapon its time in the spotlight as each has its purpose. I think it's just right.
The maps are linear with occasional "secret" collectible, as expected in this type of game. Not all games need huge open world maps for you to have fun, sometimes just a turn-off-brain linear map is the best solution.

Then there's the core of this game: Combat. A great hybrid of shooting and melee, with combos and your enemies being your healthpack. Need I say more? It plays out perfectly, it makes you truly feel like you are a one-man army, which space marines are supposed to be! You Feel OP, because you are OP by design because you are supposed to be OP cannonicaly!
Also, the rule of "I can't beat the ♥♥♥♥ out of you without getting closer" absolutely applies in this game.

Unironically a 10/10 game. I loved every minute of playing and i cannot recomend this game enough. 
(Though it might be little too short for 45€, it's your choice, but on sale it's a must-have)
